title: IAF wing commander ‘honey-trapped’ by Pak operatives; charged for alleged info leak
content: A Wing Commander in the Indian Air Force is currently under serious accusations of leaking critical defense information. It is reported that he fell victim to a honey trap orchestrated by operatives from Pakistani intelligence using social media. Allegations suggest he secretly installed software designed to steal data on a colleague's device. Prior to his arrest by the Delhi Police, he was under close scrutiny by the IAF.

title: PM Modi speaks to US VP Vance, discusses ways to deepen India-US strategic partnership
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with US Vice President JD Vance on Saturday. They discussed deepening the India-US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership across key areas. PM Modi also congratulated JD Vance and his wife Usha Vance. The Prime Minister conveyed his best wishes to the growing family. This conversation focused on strengthening bilateral relations between the two nations.

title: Kavach: What makes Indian Railways indigenous world-class tech special
content: Indian Railways is prioritising Kavach deployment on high-density and highly used network routes, which carry nearly 96% of railway traffic. Now, the next-generation Kavach 5.0 is being developed for suburban rail operations with an aim to support higher train frequencies.

title: Australia pacer takes 8/25 as Bangladesh bowled out for 54, lose match by innings
content: Campbell Thompson was the main contributor to Bangladesh’s collapse, taking eight wickets for 25 runs in the second innings at Marrara Oval. The 22-year-old left-arm fast bowler had taken two wickets late on Friday before returning on Saturday morning to claim six more as Bangladesh lost eight wickets for 35 runs.

title: Raids in four Kashmir districts in anti-national narrative case
content: On Saturday, Counter Intelligence Kashmir executed raids at five locations spread across the districts of Baramulla, Bandipora, Anantnag, and Shopian. During these operations, several electronic and digital storage devices were confiscated as part of an investigation into an anti-national narrative. As of now, no arrests have been reported in relation to this ongoing case.

title: Elon Musk says Starship Flight 13 recovery ‘not looking good’ after splashdown
content: SpaceX's Starship recovery is struggling against the tumultuous waters of the Indian Ocean, with Elon Musk admitting the situation appears grim. Despite these difficulties, engineers managed to capture invaluable images of essential spacecraft components. This visual data is expected to contribute significantly to enhancements in Starship design and its reusability. Notably, the mission marked SpaceX's most successful Starship test flight to date.

title: Two memorials of 1962 war heroes figure in 27 places formally named in Arunachal
content: The Union government has formally named twenty-seven locations in Arunachal Pradesh. These places include memorials honoring Indian Army war heroes from past conflicts. Havildar Shere Thapa and Rifleman Jaswant Singh Rawat are among those recognized for bravery. Several strategically important mountain passes and a logistics hub were also officially identified. This action pays homage to soldiers who sacrificed their lives defending India's borders.

title: Restore J&K statehood, says human rights forum
content: An advocacy group for human rights calls for the restoration of statehood and the repeal of the 2019 Reorganisation Act. They argue that statehood should not be contingent upon the regional security situation. The forum additionally demands statehood for Ladakh and its inclusion in the Sixth Schedule. Their report highlights police inadequacies despite court mandates on detentions and brings attention to the injustices faced by Kashmiris after acts of terrorism.

title: Science min dedicates to nation first-of-its-kind ‘eco-educational hub’ in Lucknow
content: Union science minister Jitendra Singh launched the CSIR-NBRI eco-educational hub in Lucknow, a dynamic facility focusing on environmental education and the conservation of biodiversity. The hub includes an enlightening heritage trail that highlights India's botanical heritage and a specialised Bamboosteum that showcases various uses of bamboo. Moreover, attendees witnessed the introduction of a new herbal formulation designed to support male reproductive health.

title: Michael Dell’s son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
content: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America.  These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers.  The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology.  Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide.  This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.

title: Scientists uncover the aluminium shield helping a tiny crustacean survive
content: In a groundbreaking discovery, scientists have identified a deep-sea crustacean, the amphipod Hirondellea gigas, which uses aluminum to survive in the Mariana Trench, one of Earth's most extreme environments. Its unique aluminum-coated exoskeleton helps resist calcium dissolution under immense pressure, allowing it to thrive where life was previously deemed impossible. This remarkable adaptation showcases innovative survival mechanisms in the deep ocean.

title: Chinese grandmother, 71, learns to swim after retirement and saves man
content: A 71-year-old Chinese woman, Liu Defang, saved a man's life after he fell into a river. She had learned to swim only a few years after her retirement from work. Liu bravely entered the water with a lifebuoy to reach the struggling individual. Surveillance footage later revealed her identity, drawing praise from social media users. Her courageous act highlights the value of learning new skills at any age.

title: Strangers rebuild Cumberland mother’s stolen farm stand for free
content: On its inaugural night, a mother’s bakery stand faced an unfortunate theft. However, a compassionate construction duo—a father and son team—came to the rescue, reconstructing the entire stand at no cost. They meticulously followed the original design, delivering a perfect replica within a week. With security enhancements now in place, the bakery has officially reopened, bringing sweet treats back to the community.

title: Mark Zuckerberg gave an update on ‘Meta's 4 am layoff email’ to employees
content: During an earnings call, Meta's CEO highlighted the difficult decision to lay off 8,000 employees, which is integral to a transformative AI-focused restructuring plan. While costs related to compensation and infrastructure continue to escalate, the company boasts strong revenue performance. Meta's proactive investments in AI infrastructure are poised to usher in new employment opportunities in an evolving digital ecosystem.

title: IN-SPACe moves to privatise operations of Rs 986 cr spaceport
content: IN-SPACe is actively on the lookout for private partners to operate Isro's new small satellite launch complex located in Tamil Nadu. This innovative facility is expected to streamline small rocket launches and improve operational efficiency. The chosen operator will oversee all functional aspects, while Isro commits to providing technical training and guidelines during a specified duration. The initiative aims to elevate India's capabilities in small satellite launches.

title: FIR against 17 for assaulting 4 transporting bovines in J&K
content: Seventeen alleged cow vigilantes are facing legal action in Ramban after assaulting four men who were transporting bovines acquired from a police auction. The brutal incident, which occurred on August 4, resulted in one man suffering life-threatening injuries. This alarming event follows a fatal encounter in April, highlighting ongoing violence linked to cow protection. Investigations into wrongful restraint and assault are currently underway.

title: Trump shoots from Senate shoulders to punish Russia, by making India, China pay
content: The US Senate approved a bill allowing President Trump to impose tariffs. This legislation targets nations buying Russian oil and gas, including India. India faces potential 100% tariffs for its energy purchases from Russia. The bill grants the president discretion and includes exemption provisions for allies. This move could impact global energy markets and US consumers significantly.

title: LeBron James’ wife Savannah reveals why Hermès saleswoman turned her away
content: Savannah James opened up about an alleged Hermès shopping dispute in Italy, claiming a saleswoman was fired after she and April McDaniel were reportedly turned away despite having an appointment. The friends later described how the store addressed the situation. Savannah also discussed marriage, motherhood and life alongside LeBron James, stressing the importance of staying grounded, authentic and invested in a relationship despite the pressure of public life.

title: Hulk Hogan’s son Nick shares family update a year after WWE legend’s death
content: Hulk Hogan's son Nick discusses family coping one year after his father's passing.  The family remains supportive and close, honoring the wrestling icon's memory.  Nick is now leading several businesses connected to his father's famous name.  They celebrated Hulk Hogan Day and continue their strong relationship with WWE.  The family is focused on making Hulk Hogan proud through their ongoing projects.

title: Kashmir route outpaces Manali as Ladakh tourism surges
content: In the period from January to July, Ladakh has welcomed a remarkable 330,332 tourists. Air travel continues to be the favored mode of access to this stunning union territory. Among road travelers, the route through Kashmir is increasingly popular over the Manali path. Enhanced infrastructure and well-planned events have fueled this tourism surge, with burgeoning homestays offering fresh job opportunities for the local community.

title: 'Shouldn't be exclusive club': Pak minister seeks Nato-like Islamic military alliance
content: Pakistan's defense minister has put forth an innovative concept for an Islamic military coalition, reminiscent of NATO's structure. This initiative follows a newly established defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey, ensuring collective protection against external attacks. By leveraging Saudi wealth, Turkish defense technology, and Pakistan's military prowess, the agreement seeks to bolster regional defense capabilities and deter potential aggressors.

title: ‘Organs unable to cope’: Jharkhand student leader’s health worsens after 15-day fast
content: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto is facing a critical decline in health as he continues his hunger strike to advocate for essential reforms in Jharkhand's recruitment examination system. In response to the protests, the government has pledged to take the demands seriously and has set up a dedicated email ID for suggestions. Protesters are requesting the cancellation of certain exams and a CBI inquiry into the irregularities.

title: Affordable housing stock shrinks, premium home inventory jumps 43%: Report
content: Unsold housing inventory in India rose four percent, with higher-priced homes seeing significant accumulation. Lower-priced properties below one crore rupees are selling faster, showing inventory declines. The overall time to sell existing stock increased to six quarters. Premium housing segments experienced both rising inventory and increased sales activity. Older housing stock is being absorbed, indicating buyer preference for near-completion properties.

title: ‘Toxic’ trailer X review: Yash’s bold scene shocks fans, netizens predict Rs 3,000 cr
content: The highly anticipated trailer for Yash's film 'Toxic' has just dropped, igniting fervor among fans. Starring alongside Yash are Nayanthara and Kiara Advani, showcasing their roles in a gripping tale of power and betrayal set in a violent criminal underworld. The public's positive reactions hint at strong box office prospects, while the buzz surrounding Yash's nude scene in the trailer adds an intriguing layer to the film's narrative.

title: Bumrah to Sudharsan: Full list of players ruled out of Sri Lanka Tests
content: Sudharsan has been ruled out of the series after failing to recover from a big toe injury he suffered during the India A tour of Sri Lanka last month. He scored two centuries in the two 'A' Tests before being hit on the toe during the second match against Sri Lanka A. He has since been undergoing rehabilitation at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru.

title: 10 bullets in her pocket, minor girl visits UP jail to meet lover, cops outwit her
content: A minor girl was apprehended at Gonda jail with ten live cartridges. She attempted to meet her lover, an undertrial prisoner, using a fake identity. Jail personnel discovered the ammunition during a routine security check at the entrance. The girl claimed she took the cartridges fearing her father's reaction. Police are investigating the source of the ammunition and the fake identity document.

title: No weekly offs, leave: Mysuru woman dies by suicide, names manager in death note
content: In a heartbreaking event in Mysuru, a woman ended her life after allegedly enduring harassment from her supervisor. She left behind a note that accused her manager of coercing her into making admissions of error and intimidating her about job security. A dedicated worker at a marketing firm for three years, her husband noted that she had been raising concerns about her manager’s behavior for the last month.

title: Nasa's Perseverance finds Mars can have warm ground but freezing air
content: Mars presents unique seasonal experiences with surface and air temperatures differing greatly.  This phenomenon occurs because the planet's thin atmosphere cannot effectively distribute solar heat.  Nasa's Perseverance rover has directly measured these sharp temperature contrasts near Jezero Crater.  Such extreme variations pose significant challenges for rover and future human mission designs.  Understanding these differences is crucial for engineering equipment to survive Martian conditions.

title: Person-to-person transactions to remain free: Govt clarifies no charges for UPI users
content: In a press release, the Ministry of Finance has said that users will not be charged for making UPI payments, and all Person-to-Person (P2P) transactions will continue to remain free. It said that if a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is introduced in the future, it will apply only to a limited category of merchant transactions above a specified threshold.

title: 'It was a complete lie': Babar refused Pathan interview? Here's what happened
content: Former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan recalled how fake news spread during the 2023 ODI World Cup after a Pakistani media outlet falsely claimed Babar Azam refused him an interview. Pathan said his face was photoshopped onto a Bangladeshi reporter’s image. He highlighted how such false stories gain millions of views, while recalling his successful international and IPL career.

title: Lionel Messi’s father Jorge Messi dies in Argentina after long illness
content: He was a key figure in Lionel Messi's career and remained involved from his son's early days as a footballer through his rise to the top of the sport. Jorge represented Messi in negotiations with clubs and commercial companies and helped build the business setup around the Argentine footballer.

title: Teen leaves MP home, travels to Mumbai seeking role in Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

Police found the boy alone in Film City and contacted his worried parents. His father is now traveling to Mumbai to bring his son safely home. The minor was found unharmed and is being kept safe at the police station.

title: Bihar should withdraw alcohol ban as it failed to curb crimes against women: Report
content: A research paper suggests Bihar should withdraw its alcohol prohibition policy. The ban has not reduced crimes against women, and illicit liquor trade has increased. Restoring liquor excise duty could boost state revenues by fifteen percent. The paper also identified education, health, and jobs as key development priorities. Bihar's development strategy should focus on these interconnected areas for progress.

title: Gurgaon, Delhi under water: 10 videos that capture rain chaos
content: Delhi and Gurgaon faced chaos on Friday due to heavy rainfall that led to extensive waterlogging and blocked roads across the National Capital Region. The Delhi-Gurgaon Expressway witnessed severe traffic congestion, with parts underwater. In light of the conditions, various businesses implemented remote work policies, and educational institutions declared holidays. The India Meteorological Department had also issued a red alert for the region, warning residents of potential hazards.

title: Too far, too late: Why pregnant women are still dying en route to care
content: In rural India, pregnant women encounter daunting obstacles when trying to obtain urgent medical care. Inaccessible roads and a lack of ambulances hinder emergency response in these remote areas. Additionally, the scarcity of specialist doctors exacerbates potentially life-threatening obstetric situations. These systemic issues often result in tragic outcomes for mothers and infants alike. Therefore, enhancing healthcare facilities in rural regions is essential to safeguard lives.

title: Why Devdutt Padikkal's fluent ton allows India to breathe easy
content: With Sai Sudharsan all but ruled out of the Sri Lanka series, Devdutt Padikkal seized his chance, scoring a fluent 142 at Colombo’s Nondescript Cricket Club during the warm-up fixture. Displaying assured footwork, confidence against both spin and pace, and solid technique, Padikkal’s performance underscores his readiness for India’s No. 3 spot.

title: Goa's 'anywhere registration' reform for property documents: What it means
content: Goa has introduced a revolutionary property registration system known as 'Anywhere Registration within the District'. This initiative facilitates the registration of property documents at any Sub-Registrar Office within a district, providing buyers and sellers with the flexibility to select offices with earlier appointment slots. Consequently, this reform aims to alleviate congestion and enhance the efficiency of public services through technology-driven solutions.
